title: Signs
about: A farmer and his family find crop circles in their cornfield and brace for what's coming.
cue: Serve the mains when the family sits down to their last supper of favourites.
faces: Serve the mains when the family sits down to their last supper of favourites.

Finish with flaky salt and coriander.Foil hat popcornPopcorn tossed with nutty brown butter, parmesan and garlic powderHow to make it120g popcorn kernels50g butter40g parmesan, grated1/2 tsp garlic powder1 tbsp oil, for poppingPop the kernels in a covered pot with the oil.Brown the butter until nutty and toss through the popcorn with the parmesan and garlic powder.Serve in bowls lined with crumpled foil.Merrill's ballpark chilli dogsMerrill's old minor league bat hanging on the wallHow to make itAs written, serves 4Grilled frankfurts in toasted soft rolls loaded with beef chilli, melted cheddar, diced white onion and a line of yellow mustard, ballpark style.Brown 300g beef mince with 1 diced onion, then add 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp ground cumin, 1 tbsp tomato paste and 200ml beef stock and simmer for 20 minutes until thick.Grill 8 frankfurts for 6 minutes until blistered.Toast 8 hot dog rolls.Fill each with a frankfurt, spoon over the chilli, then top with grated cheddar, finely diced white onion and a line of American mustard.Apple butter on warm buttermilk biscuitsSwing away, Merrill. Then pass the biscuits.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.MainsPennsylvania farmhouse pot roastBeef chuck braised 3 hours with carrots, celery and potatoesHow to make it1.5kg beef chuck2 brown onions, quartered3 carrots, chopped2 celery sticks, chopped500ml beef stock4 sprigs of thyme800g potatoes, halved2 tbsp vegetable oil1 tbsp plain flour, for gravyBrown the beef hard on all sides in the oil in a heavy pot.Add the onions, carrots, celery, stock and thyme. Cover and braise at 160°C for 2 hours.Add the potatoes and braise for the last hour.Lift out the meat and veg. Thicken the juices with the flour into gravy.Boarded-up night chicken parmigianaEveryone picks their favourite for what might be the last mealHow to make itAs written, serves 4Crumbed chicken breast fried golden, topped with napoli, leg ham and bubbling mozzarella, finished under the grill, with chips and a sharp green salad.Halve 2 large chicken breasts horizontally and pound to 1cm.Dust in flour, dip in 2 beaten eggs and press into 150g panko mixed with 30g grated parmesan.Shallow fry in 1cm of oil for 3 minutes a side until golden.Heat the oven grill.Top each with 3 tbsp napoli sauce, a slice of leg ham and 50g grated mozzarella, then grill for 4 minutes until bubbling.Bake 800g frozen chips at 220°C for 25 minutes and toss a green salad in lemon and oil.SweetsHess farm strawberry shortcakeButtermilk biscuits split and filled with strawberries and creamHow to make it100g cold butter, cubed300g self-raising flour5 tbsp caster sugar200ml buttermilk500g strawberries, sliced300ml thickened cream, whippedRub the butter into the flour and a little of the sugar, add the buttermilk and pat out 2cm thick.Cut into rounds and bake at 220°C for 13 minutes.Toss the strawberries with the rest of the sugar and stand for 20 minutes.Split the biscuits and fill with strawberries and whipped cream.DrinksBo's half-full cucumber mint spritzersCucumber, mint, lime and elderflower blended and strained, served coldHow to make it2 continental cucumbers1 cup mint leaves, plus sprigs to serve4 limes80ml elderflower cordial1 L chilled sparkling water3 cups iceBlend one cucumber with the mint, the juice of three limes and the cordial, then strain through a sieve into a jug.Chill for an hour.Slice the second cucumber into thin ribbons. Fill glasses with ice and cucumber ribbons.Pour the base in to a third full and top with sparkling water.
